description: This file defines a Logger class that serves as a wrapper around the Android platform's Log utility. It provides methods for logging at various levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error), supports message prefixing, log filtering based on log level, and caller identification for more informative logs.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A utility class that wraps Android's logging facilities, allowing for message prefixing, log level filtering, and automatic caller identification for more contextual log messages.

methods.name: Logger
methods.description: Constructors for creating Logger instances with various configurations, including class name-based prefixing, custom tags, and log level thresholds.

methods.name: setMinLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level required for messages to be logged.

methods.name: isLoggable
methods.description: Checks if a message at a given log level should be logged based on current settings.

methods.name: getCallerSimpleName
methods.description: Determines the simple name of the class that invoked the logger, useful for message prefixing.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Formats the log message, adding the message prefix.
